name: Lamborghini
summary: Luxury automotive. True black cathedral, gold accent, LamboType custom Neo-Grotesk

colors.name: Lamborghini Gold
colors.role: The signature accent color — a warm, saturated amber-gold (rgb 255, 192, 0) used exclusively for primary action buttons ("Discover More", "Tickets", "Start Configuration"). The only chromatic color in the entire interface, it ignites against the black canvas like a headlight cutting through night

colors.name: Pure White
colors.role: Primary text color on dark surfaces, logo rendering, nav elements, and light-mode button fills — the voice that speaks from the darkness

colors.name: Dark Gold
colors.role: Hover/pressed state for gold buttons — a deep amber (rgb 145, 115, 0) that darkens the gold to signal interaction

colors.name: Gold Text
colors.role: Slightly lighter gold variant (rgb 255, 206, 62) used for inline text accents and highlighted labels

colors.name: Cyan Pulse
colors.role: Electric blue-cyan (rgb 41, 171, 226) appearing as an informational accent and interactive element highlight

colors.name: Link Blue
colors.role: Medium blue (rgb 56, 96, 190) used universally for link hover states across all text colors

colors.name: Absolute Black
colors.role: The dominant surface color — used for page background, hero sections, header, footer, and most containers

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Elevated dark surface (rgb 32, 32, 32) — the primary "dark gray" for cards, panels, and text containers sitting above the black canvas

colors.name: Dark Iron
colors.role: Subtle surface variant (rgb 24, 24, 24) — barely distinguishable from black, used for footer and deep sections

colors.name: Near White
colors.role: Rare light surface (rgb 248, 248, 248) for content blocks in white-mode sections

colors.name: Mist
colors.role: Light gray surface for secondary light-mode containers

colors.name: Pure White
colors.role: Primary text on dark backgrounds — headlines, body, nav labels

colors.name: Smoke
colors.role: Secondary text on dark surfaces — slightly softer than pure white

colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: Dark gray text on light surfaces (rgb 73, 73, 73)

colors.name: Ash
colors.role: Mid-range gray for muted text, timestamps, and metadata (rgb 125, 125, 125)

colors.name: Steel
colors.role: Lighter gray for disabled text and subtle labels (rgb 150, 150, 150)

colors.name: Slate
colors.role: Alternative mid-gray for secondary content

colors.name: Iron
colors.role: Dark mid-gray for body text variants

colors.name: Shadow
colors.role: Very dark gray for text on dark surfaces where white is too strong

colors.name: Cyan Pulse
colors.role: Used for informational highlights and interactive feedback

colors.name: Link Blue
colors.role: Universal hover state for all hyperlinks

colors.name: Teal Action
colors.role: Button hover background for transparent/ghost variants (rgb 30, 174, 219)
